## OOP: Class Hierarchy & Rule Resolution

Pega dùng **class inheritance** giống OOP — BẤT KỲ superclass rule nào cũng có thể bị override bởi subclass. Không chỉ @baseclass.

| Concept | Pega Implementation |
|---------|-------------------|
| Superclass rule | Rule defined on ANY class trong hierarchy (kể cả @baseclass, Rule-, Work-, etc.) |
| Subclass override | Same rule name trên child class → OVERRIDES parent class rule |
| Inheritance chain | Child → Parent → Grandparent → ... → @baseclass |
| Resolution | **Most-specific wins** — Pega tìm từ current class lên, first match trả về |
| No "abstract" keyword | Pega KHÔNG có concept "abstract" cứng — mọi rule đều runnable |

### Rule Resolution Algorithm:

```
resolveSection(sectionName, currentClass):
  class = currentClass
  while class != null:
    rule = findRule(sectionName, class)
    if rule exists → RETURN rule    // most-specific wins
    class = class.parent             // walk up hierarchy
  return null  // not found
```

### Example hierarchy:

```
@baseclass::RuleFormMain          ← Level 0 (most generic)
  Rule-::RuleFormMain             ← Level 1 (overrides @baseclass if exists)
    Rule-HTML-::RuleFormMain      ← Level 2
      Rule-HTML-Section::...      ← Level 3
        ...specific class...      ← Level N (MOST SPECIFIC — wins)
```

### Implication for Schema Generator:

Khi resolve section include, PHẢI tìm theo class hierarchy:
1. Tìm section trên CHÍNH class hiện tại (pyClassName của harness/parent section)
2. Nếu không có → tìm trên parent class
3. Dùng `/rules/listRules` filter theo pyClassName để tìm all versions
4. Pick version applicable cho current class (most-specific class match)
